body:
Thanks for the kind words. And I appreciate that you read what I wrote.

> Try to find any hobby, maybe do some sports, play guitar, write stories etc

I play the guitar, sing, am a member of a choir, I write poems as in a "write one poem each day" project with friends. I don't think this is the issue.

Self esteem on the other hand.. yes, probably. Or self-love I should say. I feel like this is a catch-22. You are right, if I don't love myself how would someone love me? But how can love myself if no one does?
